mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fact_reconciliation_case (reconciliation_id, case_id, topic, structured_fact, interaction_claim, external_fact, ontology_distinction, correct_judgment, wrong_output_examples, next_action, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{reconciliationId}, #{caseId}, #{topic}, #{structuredFact}, #{interactionClaim}, #{externalFact}, #{ontologyDistinction, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{correctJudgment}, #{wrongOutputExamples, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{nextAction}, #{status}, #{createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{updatedAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT reconciliation_id, case_id, topic, structured_fact, interaction_claim, external_fact, ontology_distinction, correct_judgment, wrong_output_examples, next_action, status, created_at, updated_at FROM fact_reconciliation_case WHERE reconciliation_id = #{reconciliationId}
